wrap: `document` is the exact .tex imported by both suites: \documentclass{documentClass}, \usepackage for each of `packages` in order, then `preamble` (preamble-only lines such as \DeclareMathOperator are hoisted there from `tex`), then \begin{document} tex \end{document}.

expectSchema.blocks: ordered subsequence of expected blocks; type must match, every `text` substring must occur in the block's string leaves, every `fields` entry must equal the top-level content property
expectSchema.exactTypes: exact block-type sequence of the imported document
expectSchema.docText: substrings (or re:regex) that must occur somewhere in the imported blocks
expectSchema.absent: substrings that must not occur in any imported block (leaks)
expectSchema.bibKeys: citation keys that must be in the imported document's bibliography
expectSchema.export: substrings (or re:regex) required in the exported LaTeX body (after \begin{document})
expectSchema.exportAbsent: substrings (or re:regex) forbidden in the exported LaTeX body
expectSchema.exportFull: substrings (or re:regex) required anywhere in the exported .tex (preamble included)
